figure.title: SEAL trains an editor through the results of adaptation

method_contract.input: Context C plus downstream evaluation task tau during RL training
method_contract.policy: Current LM with parameters theta_t samples candidate self-edits
method_contract.inner: Each candidate independently adapts a copy of the current weights by SFT (LoRA in the demonstrated individual updates)
method_contract.evaluation: Downstream task performance determines reward; no gradient through reward
method_contract.outer: On-policy ReST-EM: select rewarded context/edit pairs, SFT edit generation to obtain theta_(t+1)
method_contract.selection: Generic positive-improvement reward; knowledge-incorporation implementation selects the best candidate
method_contract.deployment: Generate self-edit and adapt; outer reward-training loop is not required at inference
method_contract.knowledge: Generated implications are finetuning data; downstream QA omits the source passage
method_contract.fewshot: Self-edit selects augmentations and training settings; adapted model predicts held-out output
